formulation: S = f(K, C, L, U, X, H)
no_score: f is not specified: no weights, no functional form, and no evidence that the six dimensions are separable or commensurable. Six partial measurements and an unknown f do not make a seventh number, so none is computed. What is reported is which dimensions are observed, which are proxied, and which are unmeasured.

mobilization.name: Knowledge mobilization

ΔKnowledge.why: no knowledge level is measured, so no change in it is

Absorption.why: absorption is the capacity of a receiving economy to take up know-how. Nothing held measures it.

ΔCapital.why: national credit stocks move and are observed; the local level is not

mobilization.note: R3.8's housing result is this identity's shape: capital was deployed ($191-200m) and the question that decided the opportunity was not how much, but whether it could move through a structure that returns anything. It could not.

coherence_instrument.what: component AVAILABILITY: of the components an activity requires, how many are observed to exist and for how many is CAPACITY known
coherence_instrument.measures_one_facet: R3.14 called this coherence. It is one candidate indicator of coherence -- the availability facet. Coherence is whether the things an activity needs FIT TOGETHER, and availability cannot see compatible capacity, timing, rules, institutions, financing fit or operational relationships. Six of those seven facets are unmeasured; see dimension H.
coherence_instrument.why_it_is_still_worth_having: an activity cannot be coherent in things it does not have. Availability is necessary and not sufficient, which is why a zero in the capacity column settles the question and a full column would not.
coherence_instrument.counts_not_observable_as_unknown: a component whose capacity CANNOT be observed is counted with the unknowns: the activity is equally unable to plan around it

the_result: Across the 36 components of the six capabilities, capacity is observed for ONE and partially observed for one more. Housing production requires eleven components and the capacity of NONE is known. The region can say what housing production needs, cannot say how much of any of it there is, and therefore cannot begin on whether any of it fits together.
